ticket_text: I see two charges of $45.99 on my credit card for the wireless mouse I ordered on Jan 8th. Only one order was placed. Please refund the duplicate charge.
My mechanical keyboard arrived with two keycaps broken off and the spacebar is not registering keystrokes. The item is clearly defective. I would like a replacement unit.
The external hard drive I ordered was not in the package when it arrived. The box was sealed but completely empty inside. Please process a refund.

My 4K monitor was promised for delivery within 3 business days but arrived two weeks late. I had already sourced an alternative by then. I am requesting a partial refund for the inconvenience caused by the delay.
The electric standing desk arrived with the motor control panel broken. It only moves in one direction. I need a replacement control panel or a full unit replacement.
I received my wireless earbuds order but the earbuds were not inside the box. Only the charging cable and a manual were in the packaging. Please issue a full refund.
The smart thermostat box arrived sealed but was completely empty when opened. No product inside whatsoever. I need a full refund immediately.
Once again I have received an empty box. The fitness tracker was not inside. This is the third time I have had a missing item from your company in two months. I am requesting a full refund.
My robot vacuum package arrived but contained only foam inserts with no actual product inside. This is the fourth missing item I have experienced. I want a full refund processed immediately.
I was charged twice for my gaming headset order. Both charges of $119.00 appeared on my bank statement on the same date. Please refund the duplicate payment.
My electric kettle arrived with a cracked lid. The heating element also appears damaged — it takes over 20 minutes to boil water. I would like a replacement sent.
I never received my coffee maker. The tracking status says delivered but there was nothing at my door. My neighbours confirm they did not take it either. Please issue a full refund.
My DSLR camera order shows as delivered but I never received it. I was home all day waiting for the delivery. Please investigate and issue a full refund.
The gaming console I ordered was not delivered despite tracking showing it as delivered. I checked with neighbours and the building manager — no package was received. I need a full refund.
I received a completely wrong order. I ordered a laptop accessories bundle but received a phone case that belongs to someone else. Please send the correct items.
The noise cancelling headphones box arrived but was empty inside — only bubble wrap. No product. I need an immediate refund.
My tablet order shows as delivered but was never received. This is the fourth package that has gone missing with your company. I am requesting a full refund and escalation to management.
